description: Mobilità - Rilievo Flussi Traffico is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. Il Rilievo dei Flussi di Traffico si compone di: - conteggi classificati bidirezionali dei flussi di traffico veicolare presso 150 sezioni di rilievo della viabilità ordinaria; - indagine Origine-Destinazione pressoi 67 sezioni di rilievo scelte tra le sezioni di rilievo dei flussi di traffico; - indagine origine destinazione ai principali caselli autostradali regionali; - indagine ... Coverage: GeoDati - RNDT. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are eu, regionale, reti-di-trasporto. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
